_about: Sample hyper-personalized video ad scripts for FLUX 3 video (POST /v1/flux-3-video, mode t2v). Products and brands are fictional. render.py compiles product + persona + variant into one prompt. Audio (music, SFX, dialogue) is controlled only through prompt text; dialogue in double quotes is spoken.

nightshift_cold_brew.name: Nightshift Cold Brew
nightshift_cold_brew.promise: smooth caffeine that meets you whatever time your day starts
nightshift_cold_brew.look: warm cinematic look, shallow depth of field, amber and teal grade, 35mm film grain
nightshift_cold_brew.hero: a matte black glass bottle labeled NIGHTSHIFT pours dark cold brew over ice in a clear glass, slow motion, condensation beading
nightshift_cold_brew.sfx: ice cracking as the coffee hits it, a soft glass clink
nightshift_cold_brew.sonic_logo: a two-note low marimba sting on the final frame

ridgeline_trail.name: Ridgeline Trail Runner
ridgeline_trail.promise: grip that keeps up with you on any trail
ridgeline_trail.look: bright natural daylight, handheld documentary feel, saturated greens and warm earth tones
ridgeline_trail.hero: close-up of a bright orange trail shoe landing on wet rock and gripping, mud flicking off the lugs in slow motion
ridgeline_trail.sfx: crunch of gravel, a firm rubber grip squeak on rock, birdsong
ridgeline_trail.sonic_logo: a bright rising two-note guitar harmonic on the final frame

pocketwise.name: Pocketwise
pocketwise.promise: knowing exactly where your money is, without a spreadsheet
pocketwise.look: clean modern look, soft natural window light, pastel mint and cream palette, crisp focus
pocketwise.hero: a phone screen showing a simple mint-green dashboard with one big balance number and a green checkmark animation, hand holding it, relaxed
pocketwise.sfx: a soft cheerful notification chime, a relieved exhale
pocketwise.sonic_logo: a light three-note glockenspiel chime on the final frame

hush_earbuds.name: Hush
hush_earbuds.look: moody cinematic look, high contrast, cool blue shadows with warm skin tones, anamorphic lens flares
hush_earbuds.hero: macro shot of a small pearl-white earbud sliding into an ear, a subtle ripple of light around it
hush_earbuds.sfx: chaotic ambient noise that cuts to near silence the instant the earbud is in
hush_earbuds.sonic_logo: a soft airy synth swell on the final frame

night_nurse.who: a tired ICU nurse in her forties wearing navy scrubs and a lanyard
night_nurse.where: outside a city hospital staff exit
night_nurse.when: 7 AM, pale sunrise after a twelve-hour night shift
night_nurse.voice: a calm, warm female narrator, American English
night_nurse.music: gentle lo-fi piano with soft vinyl crackle, slow tempo

indie_dev.who: a scrappy indie game developer in his mid-twenties wearing a hoodie
indie_dev.where: a cluttered studio apartment lit by two monitors and a desk lamp
indie_dev.when: 2 AM, city lights outside the window
indie_dev.voice: a relaxed, slightly wry young male voice, American English
indie_dev.music: driving retro synthwave with a steady pulse, moderate tempo

trail_parent.who: a dad in his thirties with a small daughter in a hiking backpack carrier
trail_parent.where: a forested hillside trail with wet rocks and ferns
trail_parent.when: Saturday morning, sun breaking through mist
trail_parent.voice: an upbeat, friendly male narrator, American English
trail_parent.music: upbeat acoustic folk with hand claps and a stomping kick drum

freelance_designer_mx.who: a freelance graphic designer in her late twenties with a tote bag and colorful earrings
freelance_designer_mx.where: a sunlit apartment with plants and a laptop covered in stickers, Mexico City
freelance_designer_mx.voice: a warm, confident female voice speaking Mexican Spanish
freelance_designer_mx.music: light modern cumbia with electronic percussion, feel-good

commuter_student.who: a college student in his early twenties with a backpack and a textbook
commuter_student.where: a packed, rattling subway car at rush hour
commuter_student.when: 8 AM, fluorescent light, crowd pressing in
commuter_student.voice: a casual, slightly amused young male voice, American English
commuter_student.music: mellow lo-fi hip hop beat with muted keys

variants.tension: she pushes through the staff exit door, squints at the sunrise, rubs her neck; everyone else on the street is starting their morning
variants.turn: at home, still in scrubs, she opens the fridge and pulls out the bottle
variants.payoff: she sits by the window with the glass, eyes closed, a small smile, the city waking up below
lines: Your morning starts when your shift ends.
Nightshift. Smooth cold brew for whenever your day begins.

variants.tension: he stares at a crashed build on screen, red error text, drops his head onto the desk
variants.turn: he spins his chair, grabs the bottle from a mini fridge and pours
variants.payoff: he takes a sip, cracks his knuckles, the game on screen finally runs, pixel-art character jumping
lines: Two AM. One bug. Zero sleep.
Nightshift cold brew. Ship it tonight.

variants.tension: he hesitates at a slick muddy downhill section, his daughter pointing ahead excitedly
variants.turn: he steps down confidently onto the wet rock
variants.payoff: they reach a sunny overlook, the daughter laughing and clapping in the carrier
lines: She says faster. The trail says careful.
Ridgeline. Grip for both of you.

variants.tension: she closes her laptop on a wall of client messages, grabs her shoes by the door
variants.turn: cut to her running up a pine-forest trail outside the city, breathing hard, smiling
variants.payoff: she stops on a ridge above the clouds, arms out, city far below

variants.tension: she scrolls a messy spreadsheet on her laptop, sticky notes everywhere, sighs and taps her pen
variants.turn: she opens the app on her phone and taps once; the invoice sends
variants.payoff: a payment notification pops up, she does a little happy dance in her chair
lines: Con Pocketwise, lo sabes en un toque.

variants.tension: squeezed in the subway car, he checks his banking app and winces, a group chat buzzes: who owes rent
variants.turn: he opens the app, taps split rent, three friends' avatars light up green
variants.payoff: he leans back against the pole, relaxed, bobbing his head to the beat
lines: Rent's due. Three roommates. One of them is always late.
Pocketwise splits it. You keep the friends.

variants.tension: the subway screeches, someone's phone blares, a baby cries, he tries to read his textbook and can't
variants.payoff: the car blurs softly around him, he reads calmly, page turning, a faint smile

variants.tension: a neighbor's party thumps through the wall, sirens outside, his cat knocks a mug off the desk
variants.payoff: total focus, code scrolling fast, monitors reflecting in his glasses
lines: Deadline's tomorrow. The neighbors don't care.
